sonnet.q1: Held for 10 minutes; reservations expire after that. What happens to it after expiry beyond expiring: NOT STATED.
sonnet.q2: Stock is reserved before payment (Reserve stock precedes Take payment). Handling of a short line in a multi-item cart: NOT STATED.
sonnet.q4: Try to re-reserve; if that fails, refund the customer and cancel the order.
sonnet.q5: Cart is cleared after order confirmation, via an event. What happens to it on checkout failure: NOT STATED.
sonnet.q6: NOT STATED which component drives steps. Order statuses are tracked, but where is NOT STATED.
sonnet.q7: Via a payment webhook from the provider; which component receives it and how it reaches the order is NOT STATED beyond the flow Payment webhook -> Confirm order.
sonnet.q8: Webhooks can be duplicated, so they are deduped. The mechanism is NOT STATED.
sonnet.q10: Late payment when stock is gone: try to re-reserve; if that fails, refund and cancel. The decision is based on whether re-reserving succeeds.
sonnet.q11: Refunds are retried. Where the pending refund is tracked: NOT STATED.
sonnet.q12: An event clears the cart (after Confirm order). Which service does it: NOT STATED.
